name: Super ground bounce: a ground bounce that keeps the super's momentum
techNote: A metal floor (top y 0). Dash right with the jump on dash frame 1: the super (805 up, 876 momentum right) on tick 1. Stick at rest; on input 12 (after the dash's cooldown: pressed earlier, the dash waits and goes the way the dot faces) dash straight down with jump on dash frame 2: the landing ends the down dash, endDash gives back 95 % of preDashMomentum.x (dashDirection.y == -1) and sets DashBounceFrames, so the buffered jump is the ground bounce (805 up + 600 momentum up) with the super's momentum: (868.8, 586.6) after the bounce tick (tick 20). It arcs up and right into the finish box (x 630-730, y 550-610) on tick 49. `hyper` (the wave bounce: a hyper instead of the super) leaves the same bounce with 1736.7 and passes far right of the box; `jump` (a plain jump, then the ground bounce) goes straight up with 0.

ghosts.label: Hyper, then the ground bounce (the wave bounce)
